%c[ui_gray_2]Military electronics take more than a scrap of a circuit diagram. You can test the power supply and assemble the parts of a hardened PDA.

%c[ui_gray_3]Effects:
%c[ui_gray_2]- Unlocks the Milspec PDA crafting recipe.
- No recipe flash drive is needed.

%c[d_red]Requires Milspec PDA by Catspaw. Crafting needs expert tools, a PDA 3.1, 20 transistors, 25 capacitors and a K119 carbon-fibre plate.%c[ui_gray_2]

Military data buses, shielded boards, restricted protocols. You can rebuild a civilian PDA into a device fit to carry reconnaissance data into hostile territory.
 
%c[ui_gray_3]EFFECTS:
%c[ui_gray_2]Unlocks Milspec PDA crafting in the devices tab. One rank. No recipe USB required. Requires expert tools, a PDA 3.1, 20 transistors, 25 capacitors and 1 K119 plate with carbon-fibre inserts. The standard achievement material discount applies. Resetting the perk locks crafting again; an existing PDA is kept.
 
%c[d_red]REQUIRES Milspec PDA by Catspaw to be installed and enabled with its resources. Supports the standard Anomaly/GAMMA UIWorkshopCraft crafting menu. The perk unlocks the recipe; materials and tools are still required.
